The '''Cordamora Palace''' is the home of the ruler of [[Saldaea]], located in the northern part of [[Maradon]]. 

Its name translated into the Common Tongue is possibly "Heart of the People" - from the [[Old Tongue]] ''corda'' (meaning "the heart") and ''mora'' (meaning "the people or a population"). {{ref|{{twotc}}, Old Tongue Dictionary}}
